ordered_steps: Create supplier Costa Brava SL with organization number 886379250 via supplier endpoint
Verify or create purchase VAT configuration for 25% input VAT
Create supplier invoice header with supplier reference, invoice number INV-2026-1515, currency NOK, and gross amount 47650
Add supplier invoice line using ledger account 7100 for servicios de oficina
Set line net amount to 38120 and VAT 25% so VAT amount becomes 9530 and gross total 47650
Book/approve the supplier invoice in the supplier invoice endpoint
Validate posted voucher totals, VAT treatment, and supplier balance

planned_endpoints.summary: Create supplier. Related supplier addresses may also be created.
Find accounts corresponding with sent data.
Add new voucher. IMPORTANT: Also creates postings. Only the gross amounts will be used. Amounts should be rounded to 2 decimals.

rules: When email is provided, ALWAYS set BOTH email AND invoiceEmail to the same value.
ALWAYS include phoneNumber if provided in the prompt — scoring checks phone.
ALWAYS include postalAddress with addressLine1, postalCode, city, country={id: 161} when address info is provided.
ALWAYS set BOTH amountGross AND amountGrossCurrency to the SAME value on every posting.
Do NOT include postings with row=0 — row 0 is system-generated and will cause a 422.
When using vatType != 0 (e.g. VAT 25%), include ONLY the debit posting. Tripletex auto-generates VAT and credit postings.
For supplier invoices, set supplier={"id": supplier_id} on the debit posting.
For salary/payroll vouchers, set employee={"id": employee_id} on each posting.
Always resolve account numbers via GET /ledger/account?number=XXXX first, then use account={"id": resolved_id}.
Postings with vatType={"id":0} (exempt) can include both debit and credit lines manually.

payload.headline: All 4 checks failed: wrong endpoint/approach used for supplier invoice registration
what_went_wrong: Used POST /ledger/voucher instead of the correct supplier invoice endpoint (likely POST /supplierInvoice or /incomingInvoice), causing all 4 checks to fail.
Incorrectly modified account 7100 (vatLocked=false, vatType changed) which is a side effect that may have corrupted account configuration and triggered check failures.
Two failed API calls wasted time: first voucher POST failed due to vatLocked account, second failed due to unbalanced postings — indicating wrong mental model of the API.
The agent dismissed the /supplierInvoice endpoint too quickly based on read-only assumption, but the correct structured invoice registration likely requires that endpoint or /incomingInvoice.
what_worked: Supplier Costa Brava SL was successfully created with correct org number (ID: 108366705).
Correct VAT math: 47650 gross / 1.25 = 38120 net + 9530 VAT was calculated accurately.
what_to_try_next: Use POST /supplierInvoice (or /incomingInvoice) with proper fields: invoiceNumber, supplier, amount, vatAmount, and account line — not /ledger/voucher for structured supplier invoices.
Do not modify account vatLocked settings; instead find or use an account that already supports 25% input VAT, or use the correct invoice endpoint that handles VAT internally.
Search the API spec for 'supplierInvoice' POST body schema before assuming it is read-only — the scoring checks likely expect a proper supplierInvoice entity, not a raw voucher.
